summary: Classify historical Planfile validation errors separately from canonical admission failures

delivery.outcome: Classify historical Planfile validation errors separately from canonical admission failures, ensuring unchanged inherited snapshots yield explicit historical warnings and canonical readiness while keeping malformed canonical data and changed peer stores blocking
nonGoals: Bypassing repository ownership or governance boundaries

architecture.decision: Differentiate Planfile validation errors by source authority, changed-state, and admission reconciliation: unchanged noncanonical or historical copies yield explicit historical diagnostics, while malformed canonical data, changed peer stores, unresolved identities, and conflicts remain blocking admission errors
architecture.rollback: Revert the exact implementation through protected delivery

validation.evidence: Valid canonical tickets with unchanged malformed inherited copies yield historical diagnostics and complete canonical readiness; malformed canonical data, changed peer stores, unresolved identities and conflicts remain blocking
